Overall verdict: **needs_changes**. The implementer’s Repo/Env/Project declaration and structured target context are correct, and `commands_run` contains no forbidden commands. FINDING (high, correctness): `_record_outcome_score_before_flip()` still catches scoring failures, prints “lock proceeds unrecorded,” and returns success, allowing the later status flip; this directly violates AC3’s invariant that an unpersisted score must leave the plan draft with a nonzero exit—make scoring failure refuse the lock and add a regression test. FINDING (high, correctness): deletion or valid-JSON corruption of a pre-receipt sidecar is not distinguishable from legacy absence: `read_lock_evidence()` returns `legacy` whenever both receipt and file are absent, accepts any receiptless JSON object as `intact`, and receipts are only created by new writes; add migration/backfill semantics, validate receiptless payload structure, and test deleted/corrupt pre-receipt plans. FINDING (medium, test_coverage): the implementer audit timed out with `audit_status: blocked` and an empty `commands_run`, so its completion claim has no executed-test evidence; rerun the F002/F004/F005 regression suites after fixing the above. FINDING (advisory, correctness): the audit’s own finding says `Env: dev` was missing even though both its prose and structured context contain it; clear the stale finding.
